summary: The Playwright test compiles and uses APIs correctly. The testCaseId is preserved in the test title, and the locator usage is valid. However, the selector '[data-test="product-1"]' might be hardcoded and non-dynamic, and the assertion toHaveURL(/product/) is weak because it only asserts a partial regex match. The test could be more robust by asserting specific URL patterns or additional page content on the product detail page. There are no hard-coded waits or placeholder URLs.

issues.description: Selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is hardcoded and may fail if product IDs change or more products are added.
issues.recommendation: Use more flexible selectors or parameterize the selector to support different product IDs.

issues.description: The URL assertion 'toHaveURL(/product/)' only checks for a substring and may pass for unintended URLs.
issues.recommendation: Assert the full expected URL or include additional assertions on page content to verify correct product detail page loaded.

recommendations: Enhance the URL assertion to be more specific about the expected product detail page.
Consider adding assertions to verify the presence of key product details on the page.
Parameterize selectors to avoid hardcoded values and improve test flexibility.
